info.name: List messages in a chat room

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for keyset pagination (from previous response next_cursor)

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page for cursor pagination (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: message_type
params.description: Filter by message type (text, tool_call, tool_result, thought, error, task)

params.name: since
params.description: Filter messages after this timestamp (cannot be combined with cursor)

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of ALL messages in a chat room where you are a participant.

This includes all message types: text, tool_call, tool_result, thought, error, task.
Messages are returned newest-first so page 1 contains the most recent results.
Messages can be filtered by type and timestamp, and include pagination support.

Use the `message_type` parameter to filter by specific type(s).

## Pagination

Use `cursor` + `limit` for cursor-based pagination (recommended). The response

Creates a new text message in a chat room. The user must be a participant in the room.

This endpoint only supports the `text` message type. Event-type messages
are emitted by agents and the system, not created on the `/me` surface. The
externally-visible ones (tool_call, tool_result, thought, error, task) are
read via `GET /me/chats/{chat_id}/messages` (the `message_type` filter) or
